entries.name: Spherical PbSe nanocrystal assemblies
entries.caption: The spheres comprise multiple PbSe nanocrystals. Their assembly dimensions, constituent particle sizes and diffraction evidence have separate source scopes. Relative packing and ligand positions are illustrative.
